Text S1. Experiment of methane production model independent validation

Independent validation of the methane production model was conducted using swine wastewater at a substrate concentration of 5 g COD/L. Three air-mixing intensities were applied (33.3, 66.7, and 100 mL air/min), along with a control group without air mixing. The mixing duration was set to 120 min, and each treatment was performed in triplicate. Biogas production over 24 h was subsequently collected, methane concentration was measured, and the actual methane yield was calculated accordingly.
